user.title: Scalable Capital
user.description:
This reads your Scalable portfolio through **Scalable MCP**, the connection Scalable offers to AI assistants. Switch it on first in Scalable's web version, under **Profile → Security → Agentic Investing**, and set its **access level** to the read-only one unless you also trade through an assistant: this integration only ever reads, but the access level is what Scalable itself enforces.

Submitting registers this Home Assistant with Scalable - only a name and the address to return to are sent. The next screen has the link to sign in.{detail}
